name: AgMg order statuses & mails for Woo
author: agmg

sections.description: Take full control of your WooCommerce order management with AgMg order statuses & mails for Woo! This powerful plugin allows you to create unlimited custom order statuses and automate email notifications for each status. Improve your workflow, keep customers informed, and streamline order processing with ease.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 5.6 or greater is required
  • WordPress 4.6 or greater is required
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or greater is required

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option — WordPress will handle the file transfer, and you won’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of WooCommerce, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu, and click “Add New.”

In the search field type “AgMg order statuses & mails for Woo,” then click “Search Plugins.” Once you’ve found us, you can view details about it such as the point release, rating, and description. Most importantly of course, you can install it by! Click “Install Now,” and WordPress will take it from there.

Updating

Automatic updates should work smoothly, but we still recommend you back up your site.
